parameters.description:
`msg-to-discord` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your Discord channel — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own Discord channels — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional Discord channels bound per enrollment.

In Discord, open the target channel's Settings (gear icon) → Integrations → Webhooks, and click New Webhook (or select an existing one). Discord gives you a URL shaped like https://discord.com/api/webhooks/<WEBHOOK_ID>/<WEBHOOK_TOKEN> — paste the whole URL into the DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL secret.
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own Discord channel by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

webhook_url_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Discord webhook URL
